true_answer: Even statements that do not at first look like they have this form conceal an implication at their heart. Consider the Pythagorean Theorem . Many a college freshman would quote this theorem as “ a 2 + b 2 | c 2 .” This is absolutely not correct. For one thing, that is not a statement since it has three variables in it. Perhaps they imply that this should be true for any values of the variables? So 1 2 + 5 2 | 2 2 ??? How can we fix this? Well, the equation is true as long as a and b are the legs or a right triangle and c is the hypotenuse.
